scenarios.title: A｜被问国家 / 家乡
scenarios.setting: 玩家和刚认识的人聊天，对方问起玩家来自哪里。

turns.prompt: 你想介绍自己的来处或生活经历，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m from China.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m from China.
feedback.explanation: “I’m from”用于介绍来自哪里；地点信息能自然开启关于家乡的话题。

choices.text: I’m from Shanghai, in eastern China.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m from Shanghai, in eastern China.
feedback.explanation: “I’m from”用于介绍来自哪里；地点信息能自然开启关于家乡的话题。

choices.text: I grew up in China, but I’ve been living abroad for a while.

feedback.naturalExpression: I grew up in China, but I’ve been living abroad for a while.
feedback.explanation: “grew up”谈成长经历，可用来说明家乡或成长环境。

choices.text: I’m originally from China. How about you?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m originally from China. How about you?
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: I come from China.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’m from China.
feedback.explanation: “I come from China”是正确表达；“I’m from China”更简短，日常自我介绍常用。

turns.text: Oh, nice! Which part of China?

turns.prompt: 你想介绍自己的来处或生活经历，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m from Shanghai. It’s on the east coast.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m from Shanghai. It’s on the east coast.
feedback.explanation: “I’m from”用于介绍来自哪里；地点信息能自然开启关于家乡的话题。

choices.text: I grew up in a city not far from Shanghai.

feedback.naturalExpression: I grew up in a city not far from Shanghai.
feedback.explanation: “grew up”谈成长经历，可用来说明家乡或成长环境。

choices.text: I’m from southern China, but I moved around quite a bit growing up.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m from southern China, but I moved around quite a bit growing up.
feedback.explanation: “growing up”谈成长经历，可用来说明家乡或成长环境。

choices.text: Have you ever been to China?

feedback.naturalExpression: Have you ever been to China?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

turns.text: No, but I’d love to visit someday. What’s your hometown like?

turns.prompt: 你想简单介绍家乡的特点，会怎么说？

choices.text: It’s a big, busy city with lots to do.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s a big, busy city with lots to do.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: It’s pretty modern, but there are also some older neighborhoods.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s pretty modern, but there are also some older neighborhoods.
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

choices.text: It’s quite different from here, especially in terms of food and everyday life.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s quite different from here, especially in terms of food and everyday life.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: It’s hard to describe in one sentence. You’d have to visit!

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s hard to describe in one sentence. You’d have to visit!
feedback.explanation: “have to”表示有必要或受条件限制必须这样做，可用于核实办理要求。

scenarios.title: B｜询问对方
scenarios.setting: 在“聊彼此来自哪里”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“询问对方”。

turns.text: How about you? Where are you from?
I’m from a small town in northern England.

turns.prompt: 你想顺着对方的来处，进一步聊聊家乡，会怎么说？

choices.text: Did you grow up there?

feedback.naturalExpression: Did you grow up there?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: What’s it like there?

feedback.naturalExpression: What’s it like there?
feedback.explanation: 用“What”明确提出所缺的信息，请对方补充说明，而不是让对方猜自己哪里没听懂。

choices.text: Is it far from here?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is it far from here?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Do you still live there, or have you moved somewhere else?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you still live there, or have you moved somewhere else?
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: How is your hometown?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Did you grow up there?
feedback.explanation: “How is”偏向问近况；想了解家乡是什么样，问“What’s your hometown like?”更准确。

turns.text: I grew up there, but I moved to London for work a few years ago.

turns.prompt: 你想关心对方是否会想念家乡，会怎么说？

choices.text: Do you ever miss your hometown?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you ever miss your hometown?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: Which do you prefer, your hometown or London?

feedback.naturalExpression: Which do you prefer, your hometown or London?
feedback.explanation: 把两种可能列出来请对方确认，适合核对自己拿不准的细节。

choices.text: Was it difficult getting used to living in a big city?

feedback.naturalExpression: Was it difficult getting used to living in a big city?
feedback.explanation: “getting used to”表示正在适应，后接名词或动词 -ing 形式。

choices.text: Do you go back often?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you go back often?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

turns.text: A few times a year. I mostly miss how quiet it is.

turns.prompt: 关于「聊彼此来自哪里」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: I can understand that. Big cities can get exhausting.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can understand that. Big cities can get exhausting.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Yeah, I think I’d miss that too.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I think I’d miss that too.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: It sounds like a nice place to go back to.

feedback.naturalExpression: It sounds like a nice place to go back to.
feedback.explanation: “sounds like”表示根据对方的描述形成的印象，不是声称自己已经直接了解全部情况。

scenarios.title: C｜聊文化差异
scenarios.setting: 在“聊彼此来自哪里”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“聊文化差异”。

turns.text: What’s been the biggest difference you’ve noticed since coming here?

turns.prompt: 你想分享自己注意到的文化差异，会怎么说？

choices.text: Probably the way people interact with strangers.

feedback.naturalExpression: Probably the way people interact with strangers.
feedback.explanation: 指出与陌生人互动方式这一具体差异，比笼统评价一个地方更容易展开交流。

choices.text: Meal times feel quite different from what I’m used to.

feedback.naturalExpression: Meal times feel quite different from what I’m used to.
feedback.explanation: “what I’m used to”指自己习惯的情况；这里是在比较用餐时间，而不是否定另一种习惯。

choices.text: I’ve noticed people here tend to be more direct about some things.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve noticed people here tend to be more direct about some things.
feedback.explanation: “tend to”表示往往会如此，描述一种倾向，而不是断言每次都一样。

choices.text: There are lots of small differences, but nothing too difficult to get used to.

feedback.naturalExpression: There are lots of small differences, but nothing too difficult to get used to.
feedback.explanation: “get used to”表示逐渐适应；先承认有差异，再说明能适应，让交流保持开放。

choices.text: Everything here is completely different from China.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Probably the way people interact with strangers.
feedback.explanation: “everything”加“completely”过于绝对；指出某些具体差异，交流会更准确也更好展开。

turns.prompt: 关于「聊彼此来自哪里」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: For example, people seem more comfortable making small talk with strangers here.

feedback.naturalExpression: For example, people seem more comfortable making small talk with strangers here.
feedback.explanation: “more comfortable”说明怎样的安排让自己更自在，适合表达空间或互动上的偏好。

choices.text: I’m used to eating dinner a little earlier than people do here.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m used to eating dinner a little earlier than people do here.
feedback.explanation: “be used to”后接 -ing，“used to eating”表示习惯这样吃饭，区别于过去常做的“used to eat”。

choices.text: Some things that are considered polite here would feel unusual where I’m from.

feedback.naturalExpression: Some things that are considered polite here would feel unusual where I’m from.
feedback.explanation: “I’m from”用于介绍来自哪里；地点信息能自然开启关于家乡的话题。

choices.text: It’s difficult to explain—it’s more about lots of little everyday things.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s difficult to explain—it’s more about lots of little everyday things.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

turns.text: Have you had any culture shock?

turns.prompt: 你想分享自己初到当地时的适应感受，会怎么说？

choices.text: A little, especially when I first arrived.

feedback.naturalExpression: A little, especially when I first arrived.
feedback.explanation: “a little”表示少量或轻微程度，适合表达希望只作小幅调整。

choices.text: Not really. Most of the differences have just been interesting.

feedback.naturalExpression: Not really. Most of the differences have just been interesting.
feedback.explanation: “not really”是较温和的否定，常表示不太符合或并不怎么做。

choices.text: Sometimes, but I’m getting used to things now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sometimes, but I’m getting used to things now.
feedback.explanation: “getting used to”表示正在适应，后接名词或动词 -ing 形式。

choices.text: There have definitely been a few moments where I wasn’t sure what was considered polite.

feedback.naturalExpression: There have definitely been a few moments where I wasn’t sure what was considered polite.
feedback.explanation: “a few”表示少量，后接可数名词复数；比只说“一些”更偏向数量不多。
